args.rationale:
The recommendation to purchase 550 units of SKU-1008 from supplier SUP-A is accepted.

1. Demand & Inventory Baseline: Current usable inventory at NODE-BOG-F8 is 350 units with no outstanding open orders. Demand forecast is steady at 25 units/day over the 28-day horizon (700 units total). Without replenishment, stock falls below the safety stock threshold of 200 units on 2026-09-23 and exhausts completely on 2026-10-01, leaving 350 units of unmet demand.

2. Supplier Options & Lead Time: Supplier SUP-A offers SKU-1008 at $3.00 per unit with a 3-day lead time, MOQ of 100 units, and pack size of 50 units. An order placed today (2026-09-17) will arrive on 2026-09-20.

3. Plan Impact & Feasibility: Simulation confirms that purchasing 550 units from SUP-A for expected arrival on 2026-09-20 completely eliminates unmet demand (0 units unmet vs. 350 baseline) and prevents safety stock breaches (0 days below safety stock). Closing inventory at the end of the 28-day horizon will be 200 units (8.0 days of cover), meeting the 200-unit safety stock target and remaining well within the policy limit of 12 days cover (300 units).

4. Constraints & Autonomy: Total order cost is $1,650.00, which is fully covered by available budget ($5,000.00) and is within the buyer autonomy spend limit of $2,000.00. Peak post-receipt storage occupancy is 36.50 m³, well within the node headroom of 200.00 m³.
